paper_title: Stochastic fluctuations of bosonic dark matter
coupling_convention: g_aNN in GeV^-1 (plotted as log10 g_aNN), emitted as absolute value
notes: This paper is a methodological/theoretical work showing that constraints from experiments in the T<<tau_c regime are overestimated by factors of ~3-10 due to the stochastic (Rayleigh-distributed) nature of the bosonic DM field amplitude. It presents corrected/relaxed versions of PREVIOUSLY PUBLISHED constraints (CASPEr-ZULF, nEDM for axion-nucleon gaNN; dilaton/scalar couplings) rather than a new measured exclusion limit. The figures show revised existing constraints, not new original data with extractable numerical (mass, coupling) tables. No new limit is derived from a new measurement here. Local DM density rho_DM ~ 0.4 GeV/cm^3 is quoted. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Fig. 3 shows the green 'Stochastic' constraint boundary for axion-nucleon coupling g_aNN.
